company.name: Rameda
company.description:
Rameda is a modern pharmaceutical company combining world-class standards with local insights and a tailored approach to delivering
high-quality, affordable products. Placing patients’ well-being at the core of its operation, Rameda strives to help them overcome and manage
their health challenges by constantly widening its portfolio of quality and effective medicines and expanding its range of therapeutic areas.
Through its strong portfolio, manufactured within its state-of-the-art facilities and marketed to physicians through highly skilled marketing
representatives, Rameda has transformed itself into the fastest-growing pharmaceutical player in Egypt with significant growth potential.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Secondary round raised $16,270,158, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $196,025,995 to $196,025,995, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum

insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
